includes: Clap 4 derive-based CLI with subcommands and arg validation
anyhow + thiserror for ergonomic error handling
cargo-audit + cargo-deny for supply chain security
GitHub Actions: fmt, clippy, test (nextest), audit, build, docker
Generated README with cargo-binstall install instructions

faq.q: Why Clap derive instead of builder pattern?
faq.a: Derive API is more ergonomic, less boilerplate, and Clap 4's derive is feature-complete.

faq.q: Does it include a TUI framework (ratatui, crossterm)?
faq.a: No — this is a standard CLI template. Add `ratatui` or `crossterm` after generation if needed.
The README documents using `cross` for cross-compilation. GitHub Actions builds for linux/amd64, linux/arm64.

faq.q: Can I use this for a library crate instead?
faq.a: This template is for binaries. For libraries, use `cargo new --lib` and add the lint/test config manually.
